content: The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, round spots scattered across the surface — dark reddish-brown centers with prominent yellow-green halos. Top candidates: **Frogeye_leaf_spot**, **Bacterial_Pustule**, **Septoria_brown_spot**.

- **Bacterial_Pustule**: Reference (lower-right panel) shows small scattered spots with **yellow halos** on green leaves — very close match to the test image in density, halo prominence, and dark centers.

- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Shows heavily yellowed/blighted leaves with dense black spots — more advanced/different pattern than test image.

The test image most closely matches **Bacterial_Pustule** — the yellow chlorotic halos surrounding small dark lesions scattered on a green leaf is the hallmark of this disease.
